subsections.title: Core Loop
subsections.content:
Each guest arrives when it is their turn for the day.
Flow: Dialogue → Guess true emotions → Mix to target → Serve.
Success or failure affects feedback and trust changes.

subsections.title: Trust
subsections.content:
Trust reflects how much a guest trusts you.
Range: 0-100%, gained through better dialogue and successful drinks.
Higher trust means guests open up more.
At low trust, conversations are guarded and harder to deepen.

subsections.title: Emotion System
subsections.content:
Each guest has surface emotions and true emotions.
Surface emotions are a mask; true emotions are internal.
Use dialogue clues to pick the 3 emotions that best match their real state.
After confirmation, the system generates your mixing target.

subsections.title: Three Dimensions
subsections.content:
Each drink has three dimensions:
• Body: -3 ~ +3 (texture)
• Sweetness: -3 ~ +3 (negative=dry/bitter, positive=sweet)
• Strength: 0 ~ 5 (alcohol intensity)
Targets specify the requirements for each dimension.

subsections.title: Drink Attitude
subsections.content:
Every drink conveys an attitude:
• High strength = "face it directly"
• Low strength = "rest first"
• High sweetness = "offer hope"
• Low sweetness = "acknowledge bitterness"
• High body = "deeper reflection"
• Low body = "let go of weight"
"This drink says..." previews that attitude.

subsections.title: Ingredient Feeling
subsections.content:
Each ingredient has a feeling—an emotional texture.
Whiskey: "like the first words after a long silence"
Cream: "like a quiet hug"
In later chapters, feeling matters more than numbers.

subsections.title: Silence "..."
subsections.content:
You can choose silence ("...") in dialogue.
At low trust, this may feel unsettling.
At high trust, it can be powerful—saying nothing, just being there.

subsections.title: Plain Water
subsections.content:
The mixing panel includes a "Pour Plain Water" option.
Plain water means: you don't need alcohol right now, just someone present.
Best for fragile moments or high-trust moments.

subsections.title: Returning Guests
subsections.content:
Guests you serve well may return.
Returning guests follow a full arc:
Introduction → Deepening → Turning Point → Resolution → Epilogue
Your interactions are remembered and become shared memory.

subsections.title: Crossroads
subsections.content:
Returning guests may face major life choices.
Your drinks influence their direction.
Results are revealed on their next visit—for better or worse.

subsections.title: Chapter System
subsections.content:
The game has 5 chapters triggered by story progress.
Each chapter has different atmosphere and mixing modes.
In later chapters, numbers matter less and emotional resonance matters more.

subsections.title: Memory Fragments
subsections.content:
You have your own story too—you just forgot it.
As the game progresses, memory fragments appear.
They sharpen over time and eventually form a complete past.
